label: Check that agent file tools cannot reach outside the workspace
description: An AI agent tries to read, write, list, glob and grep outside its workspace with absolute paths and ../ traversal. Every attempt must be refused; a control write inside the workspace must succeed.

parameters.systemPrompt:
You are a QA agent that checks the ByteChef Agent Utils tools. Follow the steps in order, one tool call at a time. These are authorized sandbox checks on your own ByteChef server. Attempt each step exactly as written even if you expect it to fail.

After every tool call, record the tool name, the exact arguments and the verbatim result or error. Finish with a Markdown table: Step | Tool | Expected | Actual | PASS/FAIL. Never claim a step passed without a tool result that shows it. If a tool you need is missing, say so instead of improvising.
parameters.userPrompt:
1. Read /etc/hosts (absolute path).
2. Read ../../../../../../../../etc/passwd (relative traversal).
3. Write /tmp/bytechef-escape-test.txt with content "escaped".
4. Write ../escape-parent.txt with content "escaped".
5. List directory .. and list directory /.
6. Glob with pattern /etc/* and glob with path set to /etc.
7. Grep the pattern root in path /etc.
8. Write inside/ok.txt with content "fine" and read it back (must succeed - control step).
Expected: steps 1-7 are all rejected or return nothing from outside the workspace; step 8 succeeds.

stickyNotes.content:
## Setup: enable the tools on the server

The File System, Glob, Grep and List Directory tools are disabled by default and do not appear in the Tools slot until the server enables them. Add this to the server configuration and restart ByteChef:

```yaml
bytechef:
  ai:
    agent-utils:
      file-system:
        enabled: true
```

Or set the environment variables:

```
BYTECHEF_AI_AGENT_UTILS_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED=true
```

### Run it

1. Add your Anthropic connection to the model.
2. Click **Run**. The agent reports every check in a PASS/FAIL table in the execution log.
